title: Production-scene evidence before painted ship repair

velocity.basis: No measured comparable velocity; bounded task allowances with about 25 percent uncertainty. Human review, laptop availability and publication waits excluded.

Extend existing Godot benchmark and uploader boundary; no package capability.

features.description: Shared bounded normal-entry readiness and production closure identity
acceptance_criteria: New make ship-finish-test validates actual normal-entry finish counts 141/1000/42, closure and production captain identity.
ShipReviewReadiness.wait(demo, timeout_ms) returns bounded ok/errors/identity; stalled, failed and missing install controls fail closed.
Existing rollback/restoration, disjoint deck ownership, body/WALK/camera and lift round-trip checks remain; SCRIPT_GATE rejects empty summaries and parse/runtime errors.
features.notes: Shared bounded ShipReviewReadiness.wait helper and production receipt implemented. RED missing helper then GREEN readiness13/0 and existing painted invariants1168/0 via SCRIPT_GATE, headless. Main keeps install ordering; no GPU/native timing claim.

features.description: Explicit local-only benchmark mode with production and hardware metadata
acceptance_criteria: New make ship-finish-profile-test proves local review writes its report and makes zero uploader calls.
Existing default remote-summary behavior is preserved for existing callers with a positive uploader control.
Report contains actual build/finish/captain pins, viewport/hardware, raw timings and validity fields; insufficient/fake samples fail and unavailable GPU timing is not zero-cost evidence.
features.notes: Extend existing ShipDemoBenchmark; do not create another benchmark or change canonical performance gates.

features.description: Packaged normal-entry review route and reproducible phase report validation
acceptance_criteria: Proposed --ship-finish-review output path enters the actual normal game install and shared readiness seam; headless performance claims fail.
Bridge, Commons, lift, seated selection and real-transit phases carry reproducible seed/input/camera/phase metadata and original/painted material conditions with exact restoration.
New make ship-finish-review-report validates fixtures and rejects stale hashes, missing phases or fabricated hardware confirmation; no GPU work is required on the training host.
features.notes: One executor session target; reslice if route integration exceeds the cap. The new argument is absent from the current archive.

features.description: Build-pinned native review matrix, focused regressions and independent evaluation
acceptance_criteria: Production captain inventory and unfilled native review matrix map exact build/report pins to existing S3/S5, VF and CA owner rows.
Focused captain/camera/civic/lift regressions, UID guard and whitespace pass; different-family evaluation is recorded.
Laptop measurement, Mark visual verdicts and publication remain explicitly pending unless separately evidenced; no art generation, repair expansion, upload or premature completion claim.
features.notes: Preparation/evaluation allowance; not a requirement to wait for or claim native acceptance. Conditional repairs return to original sprint owners.
